leaves.name: etaW32Character
leaves.doc: Transformation law of the eta quotient v = eta(8t) eta(32t)^2 / eta(16t)^3 on Gamma0(32): v(gamma t) = (2/d) v(t) (k = 0, sum delta r = 24, sum (32/delta) r = 0, s = prod delta^r = 2); an instance of the Newman / Gordon-Hughes theorem (Ono, Web of modularity, Thm 1.64; locator UNVERIFIED); numerically checked for 602 matrices (scratch/cd-optimal/py/wchar.gp)
leaves.source: M. Newman, Construction and application of a class of modular functions (I, II), Proc. LMS 1957/1959; B. Gordon, K. Hughes, Multiplicative properties of eta-products II (1981); K. Ono, The web of modularity (CBMS 102, 2004), Thm 1.64 (all UNVERIFIED locators)

leaves.name: cdTwistedPeriodOdd
leaves.doc: For d = 5 mod 8 squarefree and every period lattice L of C_d : y^2 = x^3 - d^2 x, some period Phi_d(gamma tau) - Phi_d(tau), gamma in Gamma0(32 d^2), of the Eichler integral Phi_d = sum a_n(C_d)/n q^n is not in (1+i)L (given Lambda_d in L, proved from the eta leaf, this separates C_d optimal from the 2-isogenous y^2 = x^3 + 4d^2 x being optimal); numerically true (Lambda_d = L) for the 18 values d <= 165 of gz-optimal
leaves.source: computation (cd-optimal): non-congruence part of the period computation; not known to be printed (SPECULATIVE); see docs/research/cd-optimal.md section 4
